current_article.title: A Final Summer Surge of Mega Energy Is Approaching — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
A Final Summer Surge of Mega Energy Is Approaching
A powerful new chapter is almost here. Return tomorrow for the full reveal of what awaits in Pokemon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale.
Trainers,
Something powerful is building.
As Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale draws closer, signs of an extraordinary mega-powered event are beginning to appear. What’s waiting at the end of the summer? You won’t have to wait much longer to find out.
Come back tomorrow for a first look at what is coming to Pokemon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale!
Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.
—The Pokémon GO team
